instruction:
On the UNESCO World Heritage Centre site, compare Stonehenge, Avebury and Associated Sites; Giant's Causeway and Causeway Coast; and Pontcysyllte Aqueduct and Canal. Find each official property entry and report inscription year, cultural or natural classification, criterion numbers, property area and any separately stated buffer-zone area. Follow the criteria definitions and explain which criterion numbers the two cultural properties share and why the natural property is assessed differently. Calculate buffer-zone area divided by property area to two decimals wherever both figures are stated; keep an unstated buffer zone as unknown rather than zero. For each property, inspect its State of Conservation section. Where reports are linked, open the newest HTML report shown and its linked committee decision, report their years and two specific conservation concerns or requested actions; otherwise state that no report is linked from that section. Rank the three properties by stated property area and distinguish a boundary-modification year from the original inscription year. Use text fields, not map measurements.

Stopping condition: Stop when the three property records, common-criterion explanation, available area ratios, area ranking and latest-linked conservation/decision findings are supplied with official URLs and explicit missing-data labels.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.
